name: social-seo
description: Proxy-first concurrent Chromium runner with continuously validated proxy store, five-cycle store refresh, fast lightweight HTTPS validation, six selectable public proxy providers, live-proxy-only browser launch, exclusive automatic failover, central URL routing, and two-tab UI.
author: Social SEO

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run runtime-smoke && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
